A.notes: A has a coherent editorial idea built around flame-marked ceramics, and the warm palette, serif display type, and drawn product forms support it well. The motion evidence shows mostly reveal/progression behavior in the firing section rather than a richer scroll narrative, so it feels purposeful but modest. Craft is good on desktop, though the mobile composition looks sparse and the product/story sections feel less tightly resolved there.

B.notes: B has a strong catalog-meets-editorial concept, with a disciplined structure and a firing section whose scroll sequence clearly progresses from stack to fire to cool. Its motion is the best of the two from the frame strip, and it directly serves the brief's story. But it fails the hard contrast gate, and the font-loading errors also weaken confidence in delivery quality and performance.

raw.why: A is the better run because it clears the hard gates and remains strong overall, while B is disqualified by contrast despite having the stronger motion concept.
